summary: Thank you, Sabine. This is a clear picture: you want WellGuardian known first for advocacy, then training, then support for clinics and facilities, with gifts and wellness alongside. Most of the plan is now locked. These last few questions are about the details we can’t guess, mainly how CNA sign-ups work while your approval is in progress, and what’s ready for the store.
understood: Priorities: advocacy clients first, then training, then consulting and training for organizations, then care packages.
Your prices stay as they are. Families start with a free 45-minute consultation (weekdays, evenings and weekends), simple packages can be bought directly, and organizations get a proposal.
Client accounts include appointments, signing forms online, private messages, case updates, uploading bills and records, paying invoices, and hours used on monthly plans.

CNA course: one 2-hour live online class a week, online modules with a quiz each week, a final exam, in-person skills lab, and 24 clinical hours at a nursing home. Up to 20 students with two instructors. A non-refundable deposit holds the seat and counts toward tuition, and the balance is due before the first skills lab.
Store at launch: Stress & Overwhelm, Cancer Support, Chronic Illness & Pain and Maternity boxes, each also offered without scripture, plus build-your-own. You pack and ship anywhere in the USA.

Your dashboard shows everything daily, and the platform takes over reminders, forms, scheduling, common questions, student hours and skills, receipts, certificates and payment follow-ups. It’s just you for now, with reports for your accountant. We keep your logo, colors, wording, blog and testimonials.

followups.question: Until the State approves your CNA program, how should CNA sign-ups work on the site?
followups.why: Taking non-refundable deposits before approval could leave you owing refunds if your start date has to move. Many schools collect an interest list first.
options: Interest list only, no payment until approval
Take deposits now, refundable if the course doesn’t start
Take non-refundable deposits now
Not sure, recommend what’s safest

followups.question: How much is the deposit to hold a CNA seat?
followups.why: We’ll show it on the enrollment page and take it at sign-up.
options: Another amount (tell us in the box)

followups.question: How should the specialty trainings (dementia and Alzheimer’s, post-stroke, home ventilator, tracheostomy, PEG tube) be priced and run?
followups.why: We don’t have prices or lengths for these yet. We’ll describe them as training for caregivers and aides, not as a nursing certification.
options: Same price as your Advanced Care Support Workshops (from $233)
Each one has its own price (list them in the box)
Online only
Online plus a hands-on session in person
Included free with some CNA packages

followups.question: For the store at launch: what should each care box cost, and are your supplements ready?
followups.why: Your shop list gives item prices but no box price, and supplement pages need careful wording with no health claims.
options: Box price = total of the items (about $91–$94)
I’ll set my own price for each box
Flat shipping fee per order (amount in the box)
Supplements: show “coming soon” for now
Supplements: I’ll send the product list this week

followups.question: You said we have everything, but a few items are still missing. Which can you send this week?
followups.why: Without these, the site shows placeholders, and trust details like a real photo and phone number matter a lot for advocacy clients.
options: A short founder bio (a few sentences about you)
A photo of you for the About page
The phone number and email to show on the site
Your business address (or city only)
Please use what’s on my current website

followups.question: When would you like the first CNA class to start, and roughly how many weeks should the course run?
followups.why: Students will want a start date and length before they pay a deposit. Your curriculum needs 85 hours in total.
options: Start in November
Start in December
Start in January
About 6 weeks
About 8 weeks
